title: Algophony Listening Report
description: Schema for an AKOÚŌ × Algophony listening report on a generated soundscape.

audio_id.description: Reference to the generated audio file.

listening_date.description: ISO 8601 date when the listening was performed.

claim_taxonomy.description: AKOÚŌ claim taxonomy preserving epistemic status of observations.

basic_description.description: General description of the generated soundscape.

detected.description: Sources directly audible in the output.

inferred.description: Sources inferred but not definitively identified.

absent_expected.description: Sources expected from the prompt but missing.

spatial_structure.description: Foreground, midground, background analysis and spatial logic.

temporal_behavior.description: Temporal evolution, event density, and sequence analysis.

ecological_plausibility.description: Assessment of whether sources could plausibly coexist.

causal_coherence.description: Assessment of whether events imply believable causes.

cultural_assumptions.description: Analysis of cultural, genre, or stock-media assumptions in the output.

false_sources.description: Sources present in the output that were forbidden or implausible.

prompt_comparison.description: Comparison between what the prompt requested and what was generated.

suggested_prompt_revision.description: Proposed revision to the prompt for regenerative prompting.

regeneration_recommendation.description: Whether this generation should be kept, revised, or rejected.

basis.description: Short note describing what supports or limits the claim.

heard.description: Claims directly present in the audio, prompt, transcript, or provided description.

measured.description: Claims produced by file, signal, waveform, spectrogram, or metadata inspection.

inferred.description: Plausible logical deductions (not theory or culture).

interpreted.description: Cultural, theoretical, affective, or contextual reading.

speculative.description: Fictional, symbolic, imaginative, or possible-world reading.
